title: content/stats.yaml — stat registry (D7/D10)
description: Data-driven stat definitions loaded by platform/config into the engine/stats Registry. Adding a stat is a data edit, not a code edit (D10). Identifiers must match the canonical names in docs/glossary.md (no schema enum, so adding a stat needs no schema change; platform/config cross-checks references against this file).

identifier.description: Canonical StatID (docs/glossary.md). Must start with a letter.

label.description: Human-readable name for UI / why-trace. Optional; defaults to id.

kind.description: capability (Strength/Agility/Intelligence — read by gates/outcomes/prediction) or disposition (value-weighting axes).

range.description: [min, max] inclusive clamp for Real Stats and ToM beliefs. min <= max.

default.description: Initial / fallback value. Optional; defaults to the range midpoint. Must lie within range — platform/config / engine.stats.Load enforces min <= default <= max (cross-field, beyond JSON Schema).

gen.description: Agent-generation distribution (sampled with the injected seeded RNG, D12).

inherit.description: Parent-inheritance weight; (1 - inherit) is fresh perturbation.
